I broke down across from this shop because my serpentine belt came out. Javier diagnosed the tensioner belt was bad. After 3 hours they finished and it cost me in total for labor and parts $533.45. I asked other mechanics how long it takes to replaced it and they told me an experience mechanic will do it in less than an hour. They were nice but I know that this was a one job opportunity and they took advantage of the opportunity because I didn't have a choice.  I asked a few others about this shop and one person told me that it wasn't his first choice but they were reliable. I heard Javier telling another customer about a job that will take 5 hours and will cost $900 so I thought they would charge around $180 per hour.  If you break down near them, just know it can be pricey.
P.S. After two hours, I asked Javier how much longer it would be and he said about another hour. So my boss asked me to take an Uber to work and leave the truck there.  So I told the mechanic that I needed my belongings and that is when he said it would be done in 15 minutes.

I'm a bit disappointed how men in the auto repair business will try to take advantage of women.  I randomly stopped by this shop 1 week ago because my ac would blow hot when idle but cold otherwise.  I was asked about putting in refrigerant, and I said some was put it (might have put too much).  My refrigeratent was checked, and I was told the levels were good after whatever was done.  I was told it was the compressor and  J.R.  suggested a complete ac overhaul for my 2017 Honda Accord for $1300. Don't get me wrong, J.R. was very nice and respectful plus told me to keep the $100 for checking the refrigerant to save for the $1300. As a woman, I have learned to get a 2nd or 3rd opinion.  Bottom line I needed a fan and my air has been super cold since. This repair shop wasn't for me but could be for you.  Ladies be careful out there with your money.

Horrible customer service — avoid Cowboy Auto Parts at all costs. I called them with a serious inquiry, ready to do business, and they completely ignored me. No one picked up the first few times, and when they finally answered, the person on the phone was rude, unhelpful, and seemed like they couldn’t care less. They said they’d “get back to me” — but of course, they never did.

It’s clear this company has no interest in treating customers with respect or professionalism. If they can’t handle a simple phone call, I can’t imagine trusting them with anything as important as car parts. There are way better businesses out there that actually value customers.
I called looking for a wheel for a 2006 Chevy Silverado. I was told they don’t have any of those trucks. I was surprised.

I am a mechanic by trade and the last 45min trips to this institution I called to confirm a part is available I'd be told it is to drive there sit for 30min to an hour and then told we can't find it. Best part is the days following it does not get updated on car-part. This trip was particularly fun because the runner came back and told the cashier he couldn't find it but yet proceeded to let me wait there for an additional 30 min. Horrible experience 2 to 3 hours waisted every time I attempt to do business with them. Doesn't seem the value other people's time in the industry.
